0022600146.text: The Grizzlies (4-0, on a four-game winning streak) visit the Portland Trail Blazers (3-0) in their fifth game of the season, with Memphis sitting 2nd in the Southwest and Portland 2nd in the Northwest. Portland will be without Chris Youngblood, who is out with ankle soreness, and Shaedon Sharpe, who is out after knee surgery. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but in 2025-26 the Grizzlies lost the season series 1-3, including a 122-114 loss in Memphis on March 4, 2026.
